title: Structure Damage
description:
When a mech is reduced to 0 HP and takes structure damage, its player (or the GM) makes a structure damage check. This represents the results of unusually powerful or accurate hits, which can disable a mech rapidly if not dealt with.
To make a structure damage check, roll 1d6 per point of structure damage marked, including the structure damage that has just been taken. Choose the lowest result and check the structure damage chart to determine the outcome. Rolling multiple 1s has particularly catastrophic consequences.

results.title: Glancing Blow
results.result: Emergency systems kick in and stabilize your mech, but it’s IMPAIRED until the end of your next turn.

results.title: System Trauma
results.result: Parts of your mech are torn off by the damage. Roll 1d6. On a 1–3, all weapons on one mount of your choice are destroyed; on a 4–6, a system of your choice is destroyed. LIMITED systems and weapons that are out of charges are not valid choices. If there are no valid choices remaining, it becomes the other result. If there are no valid systems or weapons remaining, this result becomes a DIRECT HIT instead.

cases.label: All weapons on one mount are destroyed

results.title: Direct Hit
results.result:
This result depends on your mech’s remaining STRUCTURE:
  • 3+ Structure: Your mech is STUNNED until the end of your next turn.
  • 2 Structure: Roll a HULL check. On a success, your mech is STUNNED until the end of your next turn. On a failure, your mech is destroyed.
  • 1 Structure: Your mech is destroyed.

effects.note: until the end of your next turn

results.title: Crushing Hit
results.result: Your mech is damaged beyond repair – it is destroyed. You may still exit it as normal.

title: Overheating
description:
When a mech exceeds its HEAT CAP and takes stress damage, its player (or the GM) makes an overheating check.
To make an overheating check, roll 1d6 per point of stress damage marked, including the stress damage that has just been taken. Choose the lowest result and check the overheating chart to determine the outcome. Rolling multiple 1s has particularly catastrophic consequences

results.title: Emergency Shunt
results.result: Your mech’s cooling systems manage to contain the increasing heat; however, your mech becomes IMPAIRED until the end of your next turn.

results.title: Destabilized Power Plant
results.result: The power plant becomes unstable, beginning to eject jets of plasma. Your mech becomes EXPOSED, taking double Kinetic, Explosive and Energy damage until the status is cleared.

results.title: Meltdown
results.result:
The result depends on your mech’s remaining STRESS:
3+ STRESS: Your mech becomes EXPOSED.
2 STRESS: Roll an ENGINEERING check. On a success, your mech is EXPOSED; on a failure, it suffers a reactor meltdown after 1d6 of your turns (rolled by the GM). A reactor meltdown can be prevented by retrying the ENGINEERING check as a free action.
1 STRESS: Your mech suffers a reactor meltdown at the end of your next turn.

effects.note: at the end of your next turn

results.title: Irreversible Meltdown
results.result: The reactor goes critical – your mech suffers a reactor meltdown at the end of your next turn.

title: Monstrosity Structure Damage
description: When a Monstrosity-class NPC is reduced to 0 HP and takes structure damage, it makes a structure damage check. To make a structure damage check, roll 1d6 per point of structure damage marked, including the structure damage that has just been taken. Choose the lowest result and check the structure damage chart to determine the outcome.

results.title: Glancing Hit
results.result: The Monstrosity flinches in pain; it’s IMPAIRED until the end of its next turn.

results.title: Powerful Hit
results.result: The Monstrosity is knocked PRONE by the force of the blow.

results.title: Dismemberment
results.result: The attack blows a limb or chunk off the Monstrosity; it takes 1d6 Kinetic Damage and becomes SLOWED for the rest of the scene.

results.title: Direct Hit
results.result:
The result depends on the Monstrosity’s remaining STRUCTURE:
3+ Structure: The Monstrosity is smacked in the head and STUNNED until the end of its next turn.
2 Structure: The Monstrosity must succeed on a HULL save or be destroyed.
1 Structure: The Monstrosity is destroyed.

effects.note: until the end of its next turn
